note: Bridge contracts. A wallet first funded through a bridge arrived from another chain, and the trace stops there: we cannot follow a bridge to its origin and do not claim to.
coverage_warning: The L2 predeploys below are canonical and certain. Third-party bridges (Across, Stargate, Hop, deBridge and the rest) are not enumerated here, so a wallet funded through one of those will not be classified as 'bridge'. That is a measured gap, reported in the funding distribution rather than hidden.
